dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #Aranakula is at the Yasna Monument, Arabalika went to the Ruins of Dahri, and Arakunti is in the Grove of Dreams. Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon must be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: You don't seem to be afraid of anything, Golden Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: The Golden Nara is a courageous Nara. Just like Nara Varuna.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: Although Arapandu does worry about Arabalika in the Ruins of Dahri and Arakunti in the Grove of Dreams, with the Golden Nara's help, everything will be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Once the Varuna Contraption has been healed, no more bad guys will go disturb the nurseries. Aranakula would like to give the flowers there to {F#her}{M#him}.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: Arabalika is doing fine, but Arabalika is still worried about Aranakula at the Yasna Monument and Arakunti in the Grove of Dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: Aranakula... There are too many bad mushrooms, if Aranakula was caught once again...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Worrying too much won't do any good. The Golden Nara is strong and knocked down that Big Iron Chunk like a great wind blowing over rotten wood.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: We just need to heal the Varuna Contraption...

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: The Grove of Dreams... A quiet melody, the sound of the water, the sound of birds flapping their wings, the sound of stepping onto a branch...

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: Talking to Nara and Paimon... Paimon is fun. Sadly, Paimon doesn't want to become a seed.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: That's because Paimon isn't an Aranara.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: The Grove of Dreams is fine now. Arabalika is in the Ruins of Dahri, but Arapandu's not worried. However, there's lots of Fungi at the Yasna Monument. Arapandu's worried about Aranakula...

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: Arabalika should be back from the Ruins of Dahri soon. With Arabalika's Ararakalari, the Iron Chunks and Fungi won't be scary anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: If Aranakula was half as strong as Arabalika, Aranakula could protect the nurseries.

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: Aranakula doesn't even have half of half of Arabalika's strength.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: Aranakula can be braver, like the Golden Nara. Aranakula just needs time...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: There were a lot of bad guys at the Yasna Monument, but Aranakula has returned. Good.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: The Golden Nara evaded the bad guys with Aranakula and cleaned the Memory of Stone up...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Once the Varuna Contraption is healed, the nursery flowers can be brought back. Aranara won't forget.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: All that's left now is Arakunti in the Grove of Dreams. When Arakunti returns, we can go get rid of the bad bugs gnawing at the roots of the Varuna Contraption...

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: Aranakula is at the Yasna Monument. There's so many bad mushrooms there, Arapandu's worried... Arabalika...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Arabalika won't go.

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: Aranakula knows how to hide. The bad mushrooms definitely won't find him. Why is Arapandu worried?
